name: 100 Miles Down the River
desc:
No one has ever made it to Mile 100.

Build a raft with friends and ride the river.

Something in the storm is hunting you. Stay in the light.

llm.loop: build a raft with friends -> ride the river further each run -> survive storms and the creature hunting you by staying in the light -> push toward Mile 100
llm.objectives: reach Mile 100 on the river, which no one has done
llm.instructions: build a raft with friends, ride the river, stay in the light because something in the storm hunts you
unique: river-journey distance run combined with a storm monster chase
llm.thumbnails: two Roblox avatars rowing a wooden raft while a giant shadowy long-limbed creature looms in a lightning storm; calm river with a light beam on the horizon
llm.video: 1 video on page; content not shown
llm.complexity_notes: procedural or long river route, raft building, weather/storm effects, creature AI with lighting-based behavior
